newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks up slightly at quiet midsession.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks up slightly at quiet midsession.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were slightly higher at midday in a very sluggish session that saw much of the activity limited to a few individual issues.

Except for a handful of stand-out performers, blue chips were generally steady, paced by narrow gains in the bond market ahead of Wednesday afternoon's U.S. Treasury auction of $12.5 billion of five-year notes.
The Dow industrials rose 10 points to 5721, while the Nasdaq Composite gained four to 1153.
